name: Popular Foundations Ltd
about: Founded in 1998, Popular Foundations Limited specializes in engineering and construction services, providing end-to-end solutions within the construction sector.[1]
keyPoints: Business Profile[1] The company is in civil construction for factories, educational institutions, commercial, and residential projects. It focuses towards non-residential and non-governmental projects around Chennai, with successful projects in Pondicherry, Tanjore, Bangalore, Trichy, Madurai, Vizhuppuram, and Coimbatore.

cons: Company has a low return on equity of 12.6% over last 3 years.
Company has high debtors of 258 days.
